end.parentNote: Kabir practised taking away with objects and counting back on a number line. The method worked well for taking-away stories and connecting subtraction with addition. In “how many more” questions, they sometimes added the two numbers instead; this mix-up was seen again and was not corrected by the end. At home, use two small groups of objects and ask, “How many more are in this group?” Have Kabir compare the groups rather than join them.
